question: show customers from France
sql: SELECT customer_id, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'France' LIMIT 100

question: find products containing HEART in the description
sql: SELECT stock_code, description FROM products WHERE description ILIKE '%HEART%' LIMIT 100

question: list cancelled invoices from 2011
sql: SELECT invoice_no, invoice_date, status FROM invoices WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND invoice_date >= DATE '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2012-01-01' LIMIT 100

question: show line items for invoice 536365
sql: SELECT ii.invoice_no, ii.stock_code, ii.quantity, ii.unit_price FROM invoice_items AS ii WHERE ii.invoice_no = '536365' LIMIT 100

question: show invoices with their customer country
sql: SELECT i.invoice_no, c.country FROM invoices AS i JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id LIMIT 100

question: how many customers are there in each country
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country LIMIT 100

question: total revenue by country
sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON ii.invoice_no = i.invoice_no GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 100

question: average unit price by product
sql: SELECT p.stock_code, AVG(ii.unit_price) AS average_price FROM products AS p JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON ii.stock_code = p.stock_code GROUP BY p.stock_code LIMIT 100

question: top 5 products by quantity sold
sql: SELECT stock_code, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM invoice_items GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: how many invoices did customer 17850 place
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = '17850' LIMIT 100

question: how many invoices per country
sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(i.invoice_no) AS invoice_count FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 100

question: revenue per country
sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON ii.invoice_no = i.invoice_no GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 100

question: top 5 customers by number of invoices
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(i.invoice_no) AS invoice_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN invoices AS i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY invoice_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: add customer 99999 from France
sql: INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, country) VALUES ('99999', 'France')

question: create invoice 536366 for customer 17850
sql: INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_no, invoice_date, customer_id) VALUES ('536366', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '17850')

sql: UPDATE customers SET country = 'France' WHERE customer_id = '17850'

question: change invoice 536365 status to cancelled
sql: UPDATE invoices SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE invoice_no = '536365'

question: delete invoice 536365
sql: DELETE FROM invoices WHERE invoice_no = '536365'
count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE invoice_no = '536365'
